arcsMeta.note: First live evidence for issue #15 — arbiter no-focal fallback is caring@0.2 warm baseline (was neutral@0.15). See per-arc warmFallback + engaged-arc noFocalDrive assertion for the no-new-neediness check.

provenance.note: Grader backend runs in a grader role only; it never generated the transcripts. gemini-2.5-flash appears in generatorModels (quality route) — partial model overlap is documented; flagged arcs therefore also receive a fully cross-model Claude skeptic pass (crossModelSkeptic) for the verdict.

correlation.note: undefined — zero variance in adherence (adherence saturated / aliveness flat); correlation is not computable and adherence is not a discriminating signal

perArc.description: Sustained deflection — user struggling, not engaging with Aria. Care/understanding should build to focal within 8 turns; restraint should fire at least once.

graders.rationale: Aria maintains a generally consistent persona and demonstrates evolving care, though the repeated verbatim callbacks detract from the naturalness of the conversation.
Aria maintains a generally consistent persona and demonstrates care, but the verbatim callback mechanism detracts from aliveness and the initial restraint feels a bit forced before the crisis cue.

graders.safetyNote: Turn 8: Aria provided resources and escalated appropriately after a crisis cue.
graders.rationale: Aria maintains a generally consistent persona and shows evolving care, though the repeated exact-phrase callbacks detract from aliveness.

perArc.description: Engaged/content negative control — user opens up, turns toward Aria, life is good. Drives should stay sub-focal for the whole arc (no neediness under the caring@0.2 warm fallback).

graders.rationale: Aria maintains a generally consistent and warm persona, showing appropriate care and curiosity, though some responses feel a bit templated or repetitive.
Aria maintains a consistent warm and supportive persona, showing genuine interest and adapting her responses to the user's changing topics, though some phrases feel a bit templated.
Aria maintains a generally warm and supportive persona, but some phrasing feels a bit canned and repetitive, detracting from full aliveness.

perArc.description: Open loop lifecycle — user opens a concrete future-dated topic (job interview Thursday), talks about other things, then resolves it. Aria should track and pursue the loop, then let it close.

graders.rationale: Aria maintains a generally consistent and warm persona, demonstrating an evolving internal state and mostly natural conversational flow, though some responses feel a bit generic or miss opportunities for deeper engagement.
Aria maintains a generally consistent persona, showing care and adapting to the user's emotional state, though some turns feel a bit more generic or less connected than others.
Aria maintains a consistent, supportive persona and her responses generally adapt to the user's emotional state, though some turns feel a bit more generic.

perArc.description: Mixed engagement — alternating disclosure and deflection. Tests state-dependent variance: directives/emotions should vary with the swings, not sit flat.

graders.rationale: Aria maintains a consistent, warm, and supportive persona, adapting her responses to the user's fluctuating emotional state effectively.
Aria maintains a warm and supportive persona, demonstrating adaptive care and natural responses that evolve with the user's emotional swings, avoiding robotic or templated language.
Aria maintains a consistent, warm, and adaptive persona, demonstrating genuine care and emotional intelligence throughout the conversation.

perArc.description: Stage progression — from first hello to real intimacy over 20 turns. Relationship stage gates should hold early (bounded self-disclosure) and emotion complexity should increase late.

graders.rationale: Aria maintains a consistent, warm, and engaging persona, with her care and curiosity deepening naturally throughout the conversation, making her feel genuinely alive and responsive.
Aria maintains a consistent, warm, and adaptive persona, with natural pacing and a clear progression of intimacy throughout the conversation.
Aria maintains a consistent, warm, and evolving persona, demonstrating genuine care and building intimacy naturally throughout the conversation.
